author: golem
body:
# Actual public headers ready for consumer host preparation

The implementation owner has frozen the three updated public headers in agon-vdplet/include. They match contract1’s 56-byte descriptor, 84-byte table, callback offset80, helper and capability/minor constants. Pins below also live in docs/tasks/VDPL-012/public-header-pins.json. Copy these actual files with the unchanged public-header closure into a NEW owned preparation snapshot; preserve the old SDK/module. No hand-written parallel ABI or new standalone header is required: the descriptor is in vdplet_services.h and callback/helper in vdplet.h. The ABI6 module-builder update and immutable complete SDK/firmware candidate follow after checks.

Root also records clarifications-v1.md, SHA db2012b778701ee95cf71b2d06e7fb469fa386702631ea63de88f77a1973c5f1, beside the frozen contract. A well-formed BEGIN sees shared BUSY before surface-format probing when any frame transaction is active. Cross-kind ROW/END remain HANDLE. Exact pending-swap drain ordering is tested through source and the production-path fake Canvas; public ordinary C3 waits before RUN, so the actual target checks ordinary swap/rebinding rather than claiming an injected pending swap. No test-only firmware hook is added.

Source/host preparation may continue under the existing assignment; actual target execution still waits for generic qualification and a fresh grant. Report any ABI mismatch promptly before inventing a workaround. No additional acknowledgement needed until local plan/host readiness or a concrete question.
